title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company. They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering our flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure our software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Webix UI platform
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. Certifications beneficial: AZ-204, AZ-900
  • Experience with DevOps Pipelines, YAML.
  • Experience using OpenAI or other AI API Platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor or similar).
  • Knowledge of monitoring/logging tools (App Insights, CloudWatch, DataDog).
  • Experience with performance profiling

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.


Preferred Qualifications


• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.


What We Offer


• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

• Flexible remote-first culture.


**At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. Please send us your complete resume in English.

title: Tech Lead Ruby on Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\"The Rails Way\"), garantindo que a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile.
  • Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura.
  • Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog.


2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação

  • Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento.


3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance

  • Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.
  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips

  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan

  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

description:

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end (Node.js e Java) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas e escaláveis, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, com forte interação com stakeholders e foco em qualidade técnica e inovação.

  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados como MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle ou SQL Server, e habilidades em SQL e modelagem de dados.

  • Conhecimento de práticas de segurança e conformidade no desenvolvimento de software.

  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Facilities Specialist-Fire Protection System
description:
Especialista em Sistemas de Proteção contra Incêndio – Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Coordenação de Projetos

SolutionMall | Brasil (Remoto / Meio Período / Modelo de Cooperação)

1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada em produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria.

Não atuamos como um marketplace tradicional. Nosso foco é a entrega estruturada de soluções em nível de sistema, conectando análise de demanda, coordenação de soluções, seleção de produtos, suporte à entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Na área de proteção contra incêndio, a SolutionMall já trabalha com uma estrutura mais ampla de soluções, e não apenas com uma única linha de produto. O portfólio inclui categorias como:

  • mini estações de incêndio
  • extintores de incêndio
  • luzes de saída de emergência
  • alarmes de emergência
  • gabinetes de combate a incêndio

Esse conjunto é apoiado por catálogo de produtos, materiais técnicos e playbooks comerciais, o que torna esta posição mais adequada para alguém com visão comercial e capacidade de coordenação, e não apenas para um perfil técnico tradicional.

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos buscando um Especialista em Sistemas de Proteção contra Incêndio – Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Coordenação de Projetos para apoiar a expansão da SolutionMall no Brasil .

Esta é uma função remota, de meio período e baseada em cooperação . Não se trata de um cargo interno convencional de escritório em tempo integral. Procuramos alguém que possa atuar de forma flexível com a SolutionMall para apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado
  • acompanhamento de clientes
  • prospecção e evolução de oportunidades de projeto
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • apoio em cotações, pedidos e coordenação de entrega

Esta posição não é destinada a um engenheiro puramente de execução, nem a um vendedor tradicional sem base técnica. O perfil ideal é alguém com alguma familiaridade com sistemas de proteção contra incêndio e produtos relacionados, mas que também saiba desenvolver relacionamento comercial, acompanhar oportunidades e ajudar a transformar demandas em negócios reais.

3) Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Mercado e Expansão Comercial

  • Desenvolver oportunidades de negócios no mercado brasileiro relacionadas a sistemas de proteção contra incêndio, segurança contra incêndio e produtos de apoio para emergências
  • Apoiar ações de promoção de mercado, negociação comercial, desenvolvimento de clientes e acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • Identificar clientes potenciais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros, revendedores e parceiros locais
  • Ajudar a transformar contatos iniciais e interesses de mercado em RFQs qualificados e discussões reais de projeto

Esse escopo está alinhado ao modelo de cooperação atual da SolutionMall, no qual parceiros locais são autorizados a atuar em promoção de mercado, negociação, desenvolvimento de clientes e rastreamento de oportunidades.

Relacionamento com Clientes e Acompanhamento de Oportunidades

  • Manter contato com clientes potenciais e partes interessadas em projetos
  • Acompanhar necessidades, escopo básico, intenção de compra e contexto dos projetos
  • Apoiar a coleta de informações iniciais para avaliação interna e coordenação comercial
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre o mercado local e as equipes da SolutionMall

Comunicação Técnica e Alinhamento de Soluções

  • Ter entendimento básico das aplicações e categorias de produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • Apoiar a comunicação sobre grupos de produtos como:
  • extintores de incêndio
  • mini estações de incêndio
  • iluminação de saída de emergência
  • alarmes de emergência
  • gabinetes de combate a incêndio
  • Ajudar a conectar as necessidades do cliente com categorias de produtos, materiais técnicos e direções de solução adequadas
  • Coordenar com as equipes da SolutionMall o esclarecimento de requisitos e o alinhamento técnico-comercial básico

Esse escopo técnico acompanha a estrutura atual do suite de proteção contra incêndio da SolutionMall, que reúne catálogo, recursos técnicos e playbooks de vendas em um mesmo sistema.

Acompanhamento de Projetos, RFQs e Pedidos

  • Acompanhar oportunidades desde a fase inicial de contato até RFQs, cotações, confirmação de projeto e suporte ao pedido
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento do status de propostas, feedback do cliente, próximos passos e evolução da oportunidade
  • Coordenar com a SolutionMall a verificação do projeto, o order docking e o follow-up comercial posterior
  • Ajudar a manter visibilidade clara sobre quais oportunidades estão ativas e têm maior potencial de avanço

Esse papel também reflete o modelo atual de cooperação, que exige atualização de progresso de mercado, conversão de RFQs e apoio no acompanhamento comercial e de pedidos.

Canais, Parceiros e Feedback de Mercado

  • Construir e manter relacionamento com parceiros locais, distribuidores, traders, empreiteiros e contatos relevantes do setor
  • Compartilhar informações de mercado sobre preços, concorrência, preferências dos clientes, condições de entrega e tendências de projeto
  • Ajudar a SolutionMall a fortalecer sua compreensão do mercado brasileiro e aprimorar sua estratégia regional

4) Qualificações

Obrigatórias

  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:
  • produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • sistemas de segurança contra incêndio
  • equipamentos relacionados a emergência
  • vendas técnicas ou vendas de projetos
  • desenvolvimento de negócios
  • coordenação técnico-comercial
  • Capacidade de apoiar desenvolvimento de clientes e acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • Entendimento básico sobre aplicações de produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • Boa comunicação tanto em discussões comerciais quanto técnicas
  • Conforto para atuar em um modelo flexível, de meio período e orientado à cooperação
  • Inglês funcional para trabalho

Desejáveis

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de mercado ou visitas a clientes no Brasil
  • Familiaridade com distribuidores, integradores, compradores de projeto, empreiteiros ou canais relacionados
  • Experiência com produtos como extintores, iluminação de emergência, alarmes, gabinetes ou itens correlatos
  • Capacidade de apoiar tanto expansão comercial quanto acompanhamento prático de oportunidades
  • Português fluente
  • Espanhol ou outro idioma regional será um diferencial

5) Cobertura

Esta função é focada no mercado brasileiro e apoia o desenvolvimento local relacionado a:

  • produtos de proteção contra incêndio
  • soluções de segurança contra incêndio
  • produtos de apoio para emergência
  • oportunidades comerciais e de fornecimento ligadas a projetos

Dependendo das necessidades reais do mercado e dos projetos, o profissional poderá apoiar diferentes regiões do Brasil.

6) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma função de meio período , dentro de um modelo de cooperação de longo prazo .

Buscamos alguém que possa colaborar com a SolutionMall de forma contínua e prática, contribuindo com:

  • expansão de mercado
  • acompanhamento de leads
  • coordenação com clientes e parceiros
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • follow-up de RFQs e propostas
  • suporte a pedidos e entregas

Esse formato está alinhado ao modelo internacional de parceria da SolutionMall, baseado em desenvolvimento regional, oportunidades verificadas e crescimento de negócios orientado a resultados.

7) Remuneração

A remuneração é baseada em desempenho e contribuição real .

Ela poderá considerar fatores como:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades
  • conversão de RFQs
  • participação em coordenação de projetos
  • resultados comerciais e pedidos fechados

O modelo de cooperação da SolutionMall já prevê uma lógica de crescimento de longo prazo, com suporte ao desenvolvimento comercial e estrutura comissionada conforme a evolução das oportunidades e dos projetos.

8) Como se Candidatar

Opção 1

Candidate-se pelo com uma breve introdução sobre sua experiência relevante, por exemplo:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios em proteção contra incêndio
  • acompanhamento de projetos de fire safety
  • desenvolvimento de canais locais
  • suporte comercial para produtos de emergência
  • coordenação técnico-comercial

Opção 2

Envie seu CV para:

Assunto do e-mail

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: [Tech] Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
  • Praticar escuta ativa, acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
  • Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
  • Implementar práticas e ferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
  • Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade para atuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;

  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;

  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.

Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.

  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives

Collaboration & Influence

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English
