title: Software engineering manager
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE
The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.
In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.
• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, Type Script, AWS).
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, Dev Ops practices, and software delivery processes.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:
Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback:Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated1st year and 2nd year students(not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who arehungry, quick learners, and committedto excelling in a fast-paced environment.How to Apply:
Get your application in now!

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias:Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/PostgresVisão geral da posição
ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development
Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications
Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Data analyst
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Analyst to support our data management and analytics initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in data quality, data analysis, and data governance, with hands-on experience using Metaplane for data observability. The ideal candidate will also bring capabilities in data lineage, business glossary management, and data stewardship to ensure data integrity, usability, and compliance across the organization.The Responsibilities
Implement and monitor data quality frameworks and rules using Metaplane
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data anomalies and pipeline issues
Define and track data quality metrics and KPIs
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and insights
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into data solutions
Support reporting and analytics initiatives with accurate and reliable data
Document and maintain end-to-end data lineage across systems
Ensure traceability of data from source to consumption
Support impact analysis for data changes
Ensure consistent use of data terms across the organization
Partner with business and technical teams to align terminology
Act as a data steward for assigned domains
Enforce data governance policies, standards, and best practices
Support data ownership, and lifecycle managementRequirements
Proven experience as a Technical Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role
Hands-on experience withMetaplane(required)
Strong knowledge of:
Experienced in Data Quality frameworks and tools
Strong experience in Data Analysis techniques and tools (SQL, Python, etc.)
Experience in Data Lineage concepts and tools
Business Glossary and metadata management
Data Governance and Data Stewardship practices
Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., GCP, Big Query)
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Strong English communication skills

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets.
Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions.
Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant.
Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automatedhedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols.
Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market Development
Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets.
Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications
Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias:Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/PostgresVisão geral da posição
ComoEngenheiro(a) de Software Principalna equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataformaQualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria

title: Executivo de território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!
Responsabilidades:
Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;
Requisitos e qualificações
Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
Carteira de motorista B;
Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand: A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia; A Legrand hoje:
Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano; História recente:
Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa Plataforma de carreira da nova economia com mais 10 mil alunos formados. Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos, pós graduação e mestrados internacionais. Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.
Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais
Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias. Aqui no grupo Unilife acreditamos que o verdadeiro sucesso vem de uma equipe engajada e inspirada. Nossa cultura reflete nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho que não apenas apoie o crescimento e o desenvolvimento profissional, mas também valorize cada membro da equipe, acreditamos que cada colaborador tem papel essencial na concretização da visão de impacto social da empresa. Aqui nossos colaboradores tem possibilidade e visão de crescimento no nosso ecossistema.
Estamos contratando Consultor de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. As principais responsabilidades incluem atender clientes, buscar clientes, identificar suas necessidades e recomendar soluções educacionais alinhadas às suas metas. Você também será responsável por acompanhar negociações, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir um alto nível de satisfação do cliente. Este é um cargo presencial e em regime de contratação.
Qualificações
Consultoria de Vendas: Experiência em consultoria de vendas, conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e habilidade para identificar oportunidades no mercado. Relacionamento com o Cliente: Competência em manter a satisfação do cliente e oferecer um serviço de alta qualidade que corresponda ou supere as expectativas. Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz para interações cliente e equipe, auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas e esclarecimento de informações. Experiência em consultoria e atendimento ao cliente será um diferencial, assim como familiaridade com o setor educacional e ferramentas de CRM.
Informações Indispensáveis: Modalidade PJ de trabalho Modelo de trabalho híbrido: Segunda a sexta presencial e sábado home office.
O que é importante para o perfil: Desejo de crescer na sua carreira Desejo de sempre aprender novas habilidades Desejo de sempre melhorar suas técnicas Sempre está se capacitando sobre o tema vendas Desenvolve Skills de comunicação, relação interpessoal e inteligência emocional
Experiência: Mínimo de 30 vendas no período de 90 dias.
Remuneração Salário + Ajuda de custo + Comissão + bonificações
FIXO Júnior (até R$150.000) R$1.700 Pleno (R$151k–R$250k) R$2.200 Sênior (R$251k–R$300k) R$2.850 Expert (R$301k–R$320k) R$3.400
Ajuda de custo R$595
Comissões e bonificações são informados no processo seletivo

Ensino médio completo

title: Customs specialist
description:
Responsibilities:
Responsible for accurately reviewing customs codes,proficiently applying trade preferential policies and relevant tax rules, conducting tariff analysis and commodity classification audits on imported and exported goods, and adopting legal and compliant tariff preferential tax rules;
Coordinate the system requirements docking of the customs information module,implement the construction and functional improvement of the customs clearance
system;
Served as a consultant for customs system, responsible for daily business system operation cooperation, online and daily exception handling, processing trade compliance self
inspection,management,etc:
Responsible for communicating with local customs and
handling abnormal issues.
Qualifications:
College degree or above,
Able to work overseas for 3 year or more,
Strong proficiency in English/Chinese for Portuguese Native Speakers (listening,speaking, reading, and writing). Or strong proficiency in Portuguese for Chinese Native Speakers:
Master professional knowledge of customs business, be familiar with customs clearance process essentials and customs policies and regulations; Familiar with customs inspection expertise,trade security knowledge, customs related laws and regulations, etc.. with certain ability to identify customs declaration risks:
Familiar with product classification and have participated in the construction of customs clearance systems;
Having clear logical thinking, good communication and teamwork skills, and the ability to flexibly respond and solve problems;
Experience in supporting overseas logistics or customs related work, with overseas permanent residency experience preferred.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:

Assistência Administrativa: Habilidade em prestar suporte administrativo e gerenciar tarefas comuns de escritório de forma organizada e eficiente.

Experiência prévia comprovada na área administrativa e domínio do pacote Microsoft Office serão considerados diferenciais significativos.

title: Game presenters (relocation to armenia)
description:

Always uphold the highest professional standards.

Passion for delivering exceptional customer service.

Company accommodation.

Access to free language courses.
Teambuilding activities and corporate events.
Complimentary tea, coffee, and refreshments.
Flexible working schedule.
Free parking facilities.
Privilege card for additional perks.
Corporate gym access.

title: Coordenador(a) de dho
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:
Coordenar de forma integrada as frentes de Recrutamento e Seleção, Treinamento e Desenvolvimento, Cultura e Clima Organizacional nas unidades da BPN, garantindo a execução padronizada das práticas de DHO em alinhamento com as diretrizes estratégicas da companhia.
Garantir o planejamento e execução dos programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança.
Coordenar a condução dos processos seletivos e assegurar o alinhamento dos perfis contratados à cultura da empresa.
Coordenar o desdobramento e a execução dos projetos estratégicos de sucessão, cultura organizacional, employer branding e engajamento, assegurando a adaptação às necessidades locais e o alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.
Coordenar o processo de avaliação de desempenho, garantindo sua aplicação conforme os ciclos definidos, apoiando as lideranças na análise dos resultados e no planejamento de ações de desenvolvimento individual e organizacional.
Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento da área, controlando investimentos em treinamento e seleção.
Acompanhar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho da área de DHO, propondo planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
Garantir a execução e padronização dos processos conforme as diretrizes corporativas de RH.
Atuar como parceiro das lideranças na construção e execução de soluções de desenvolvimento humano.
Representar a área de DHO em auditorias, reuniões corporativas e projetos transversais da companhia.
Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.
Requisitos:

description:

Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. title: Implementation analyst
description:
Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:Brazil
Type:Full-Time Contract
Setup:Fully Remote
Level:Mid-Level
Industry:Software SAAS Company
Shift:US Hours
Start Date:can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment:Available upon request
Rate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Alteryx server specialist - latam based
description:
Position Summary
Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.Position Overview
We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.Responsibilities:
Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.Qualifications:
Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
Proficiency with Alteryx Server
Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Gerente suínocultura
description:
Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.
Principais Responsabilidades Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate). Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
Garantir bem-estar animal.
Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Advogado associado
description:
Rodrigo Galvão Sociedade Individual de Advocacia está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Associado(a) para integrar sua equipe jurídica e atuar de forma híbrida, em regime integral.
Sobre o Escritório: Rodrigo Galvão Sociedade Individual de Advocacia é um escritório dedicado a oferecer soluções jurídicas estratégicas e personalizadas, com atuação pautada pela ética, excelência técnica e compromisso com resultados.
Nosso trabalho é orientado pela construção de relações de confiança com os clientes, buscando sempre soluções jurídicas eficientes e inovadoras. Atuamos principalmente nas áreas ambiental, minerária, administrativo e cível, assessorando empresas e investidores em questões regulatórias, contratuais e contenciosas.
Valorizamos profissionais comprometidos com o aprimoramento contínuo, a qualidade técnica e a colaboração profissional.
Sobre a Vaga: Buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Associado(a) para atuação híbrida, em regime integral e sem exclusividade, com foco nas áreas de Direito da Mineração, Direito Ambiental, Administrativo e Direito Civil.
A atuação envolverá atividades consultivas e contenciosas, incluindo análise jurídica estratégica e acompanhamento de demandas administrativas e judiciais.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Elaboração de pareceres e peças jurídicas;
Realização de pesquisas legislativas, doutrinárias e jurisprudenciais;
Prestação de consultoria jurídica estratégica a clientes;
Elaboração e revisão de contratos e instrumentos jurídicos;
Acompanhamento de processos administrativos e judiciais;
Atuação em negociações e tratativas jurídicas em defesa dos interesses dos clientes.
Requisitos:
Registro ativo na OAB (obrigatório);
Formação em Direito;
Boa capacidade de pesquisa jurídica, redação técnica e análise crítica;
Organização, responsabilidade e autonomia no trabalho híbrido;
Bom relacionamento interpessoal e facilidade para atuar em ambiente colaborativo.
Diferenciais:
Experiência nas áreas de atuação;
Experiência em consultoria empresarial e contratos;
Idioma inglês é recomendado.
Regime de Associação:
Regime de advogado associado, nos termos do Estatuto da Advocacia;
Trabalho híbrido;
Dedicação integral, sem exclusividade;
Remuneração mensal e percentual sobre honorários a serem definidos em comum acordo entre as partes.
Como se candidatar:
Os interessados podem encaminhar currículo e breve apresentação profissional por meio do Linked In ou para o e-mail a ser informado no anúncio.

title: Analista de requisitos
description:
Diariamente esse profissional vai:
Levantamento e especificação de requisitos de sistema;
Desenvolver e comunicar explicitamente a Meta do Produto; Criar, juntamente com os demais integrantes do Time, as Metas das Sprints;

Monitorar a aplicação de processos de trabalho e melhores práticas pelas equipes de desenvolvimento, assegurando a execução do plano de trabalho firmado com o cliente;
Identificação de riscos para acompanhamento durante todo o ciclo de vida da execução dos serviços;
Elaboração, construção e manutenção de manuais
Se ligue que você precisa de:
Ensino Superior completo em TI;
Sólida experiência ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos;
Certificação SFC (Scrum Fundaments Certified)
Experiencia mínima de 3 anos;
Mas vai ser ótimo :
Se você conhecer metodologias ágeis. Utilização de banco de dados Microsoft SQL Server, My SQL, Postgre SQL em ambiente cliente/servidor ou web;
Se você ter as certificação reconhecida em Product Owner (PSPO ou CSPO), Certificação em Kanban (TKP ou KMP).
