title: Strategy consultant | ex-mckinsey, bain, bcg, deloitte, kpmg (100% remote)
description:
Apply here:
About the role
We are looking for a sharp, execution-oriented strategy professional to work directly with C-suite clients across multiple industries. You will own workstreams end-to-end, from problem structuring and hypothesis development to stakeholder alignment and final delivery.
This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role designed for professionals who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually demanding environments and who are used to that standard from tier-1 consulting firms.
Who we're looking for:
Professionals with a background in top-tier global strategy or management consulting firms (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, KPMG, Pw C, EY, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, or equivalent). The rigor, structure, and pace expected here mirrors what you already know.
What you will do:
Lead hypothesis-driven diagnostic and strategy engagements for clients across sectors
Own workstream delivery: structuring the problem, building the analytical framework, and presenting findings to senior leadership
Drive C-suite and board-level stakeholder management with executive communication and influence
Translate complex data and qualitative insights into clear, actionable strategic recommendations
Support business development conversations and contribute to proposal writing when relevant
Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, globally distributed teams Apply here:
What we expect
3-8 years of experience in a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm (MBB, Big4 Strategy, or equivalent tier-1 firm)
Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive engagement delivery from kickoff to final output
Strong financial modeling and data analysis skills
Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to C-level executives
Ability to operate with high autonomy in a fully remote, async-first environment
Advanced English Apply here:
This is an external position to work at a Wise VAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that Wise VAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in Wise VAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.

description:

SOBRE NÓS
A Vixting está revolucionando a Admissão Digital e a Gestão Ocupacional no Brasil!
Com tecnologia de ponta, oferecemos soluções práticas e inteligentes que simplificam a rotina dos nossos clientes. Aqui, nosso foco vai além de serviços: acreditamos nas pessoas e na força de conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem um valor único e que o alinhamento cultural é o alicerce para relações duradouras e impactantes. Aqui, construímos conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão por superar expectativas
Criamos soluções estratégicas
Somos apaixonados pelo maior ativo de uma companhia: Pessoas! Prezamos a essência de cada ser humano, buscamos o fit cultural para ser a base da nossa relação. Construímos relacionamentos baseados em confiança, caráter, honestidade, ética e paixão por encantar!
DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK SÊNIOR
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Core Técnico: Experiência sólida e comprovada em Node.js, React.js, Type Script e Java Script;
Cloud & Serverless: Vivência prática em ambiente AWS, com foco em arquitetura Serverless e AWS Lambda;
Mensageria: Experiência com sistemas de filas (especialmente AWS SQS);
Banco de Dados: Proficiência em My SQL e Mongo DB;
Dev Ops: Experiência na configuração de fluxos de CI/CD com Git Hub Actions;
Arquitetura: Conhecimento em quebra de monolitos e transição para microsserviços/serverless;
Produtividade: Utilização de ferramentas de IA no fluxo de trabalho diário para ganho de performance. Diferenciais (Serão considerados um grande peso)
Conhecimento em Dynamo DB (banco chave-valor).
Background no setor de Healthtech (especialmente medicina ocupacional).
Experiência prévia em empresas de software para RH, Recrutamento ou Onboarding. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
Nossos Benefícios
Vale refeição de R$36,00 por dia, sendo 22 dias úteis fixos;
Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;
Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;
Plano odontológico Amil;
Wellhub;
Seguro de vida;
Day off.

title: Senior electrical bim engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U. S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.
We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:
Eracore is growing in Brazil, and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U. S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.
Why You'll Enjoy Working at Eracore
Competitive hourly pay
Continuing Education
Sports & Fitness
Fully remote work
Healthy work–life balance
Learning platforms for professional growth
Supportive leadership and mentorship Your Role
Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools. What We're Looking For
4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
Strong understanding of electrical systems
Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
Team-oriented mindset with mentoring experience
Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused
Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

title: Analista de requisitos
description:
Diariamente esse profissional vai:
Levantamento e especificação de requisitos de sistema;
Desenvolver e comunicar explicitamente a Meta do Produto; Criar, juntamente com os demais integrantes do Time, as Metas das Sprints;
Análise de problemas e proposição de soluções;
Serviço técnico de modelagem de processos de negócio e especificação de requisitos de sistemas de informação;
Definição de escopo, modelagem de dados, desenvolvimento de projeto lógico e elaboração de protótipo;
Elaboração de documentos de histórias de usuários, registro de acompanhamento do projeto;
Realizar a gestão eficaz do Backlog do Produto;
Participar de todas as Reuniões de Planejamento, Revisão e Retrospectiva da Sprint; Participar da Reunião Diária, quando solicitado, Esclarecer dúvidas do time sobre as regras de negócio;
Contribuir no desenho de soluções inovadoras e de valor para o cliente;
Monitorar a aplicação de processos de trabalho e melhores práticas pelas equipes de desenvolvimento, assegurando a execução do plano de trabalho firmado com o cliente;
Identificação de riscos para acompanhamento durante todo o ciclo de vida da execução dos serviços;
Elaboração, construção e manutenção de manuais Se ligue que você precisa de:
Ensino Superior completo em TI;
Sólida experiência ferramentas de desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos;
Certificação SFC (Scrum Fundaments Certified)
Experiencia mínima de 3 anos; Mas vai ser ótimo :
Se você conhecer metodologias ágeis. Utilização de banco de dados Microsoft SQL Server, My SQL, Postgre SQL em ambiente cliente/servidor ou web;
Se você ter as certificação reconhecida em Product Owner (PSPO ou CSPO), Certificação em Kanban (TKP ou KMP).

title: Ps project coordinator
description:
This position is Remote from Brazil only.
If it interests you please share your CV, and Availability to speak with me in PST time zone #
Rate $22.5/hr
6 months+ Extension
Fluent (speak, read, and write) in both Spanish and English. Portuguese is a plus.
MUST HAVE:
Experience with Google's G Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides).
Determine customer and *** project contacts from the Statement of Work.
Identify resources needed and assign or request the resource assignment to the engagement.
In conjunction with project stakeholders, establish project kickoff call and project start dates.
Develop a project schedule using appropriate tools and techniques and revise it to meet changing needs.
Ensure that all team members (internal and customer) understand the project's scope and what they are individually responsible for.
Maintain schedules of what tasks must be completed by what date, as well as team meetings. Coordinate and communicate schedule information to the project team.
Create and execute project work schedules and revise them as appropriate to meet changing needs.
Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately.
Track and report team hours and expenses on a weekly basis.
Create and provide weekly customer status reports throughout the engagement until the purchased Time & Expense is exhausted or Firm Fixed Priced deliverables are completed.
Good communication skills, including written, verbal, presentation, and adaptive (multi-level).
Good organizational skills, including tool utilization (spreadsheets, project management tools, mind maps), information capture, attention to detail, and prioritization.
Flexible to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines; able to promptly and efficiently react to project adjustments and alterations.

title: Closer comercial
description:
Vaga: Consultor(a) Comercial – Programa Flowgrammers
A Flowgrammers, iniciativa que faz parte do ecossistema da Ecosistema ED Soluções, está em busca de pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, que queiram evoluir profissionalmente e fazer parte de um projeto que está em forte expansão.
Nosso propósito vai além de apenas vender. Trabalhamos com formação de pessoas, desenvolvimento comercial e liderança, criando um ambiente onde cada profissional tem a oportunidade de aprender, crescer e avançar para novos níveis dentro da organização.
Buscamos alguém com coração ensinável, que tenha sede de desenvolvimento, disciplina para executar e ambição de construir uma carreira sólida dentro de um time que valoriza cultura organizacional de alta performance.
Principais responsabilidades
• Prospecção de novos clientes e oportunidades de negócio
• Qualificação de leads e condução de reuniões comerciais
• Apresentação da solução e condução do processo de venda
• Desenvolvimento contínuo dentro do nosso método comercial
• Contribuir para o crescimento do time e do projeto
O que oferecemos
• Mentoria e desenvolvimento profissional focados em vendas, liderança e crescimento pessoal
• Participação em um projeto inovador e em forte crescimento
• Valor mínimo garantido para suporte inicial
• Comissões agressivas e possibilidade real de ganhos crescentes semanais
• Ambiente com cultura de alta performance e evolução constante
• Possibilidade de crescimento e absorção em novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema ED Soluções
Perfil que buscamos
• Pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento
• Perfil comunicativo e orientado a resultados
• Vontade real de aprender, evoluir e crescer profissionalmente
• Espírito de equipe e comprometimento com metas
• Interesse em desenvolver carreira na área comercial
Essa é uma oportunidade para quem quer sair do lugar comum e construir uma trajetória de crescimento real dentro de um ecossistema que forma pessoas e desenvolve líderes.
Se você sente que está pronto para avançar para o próximo nível, candidate-se.

title: Game animator – igaming
description:
Game Animator | Rapid Play Games Remoto | PJ | Full-time Produto global | Slots & Casino
Na Rapid Play Games, nossos jogos não apenas funcionam — eles encantam. Cada spin, cada transição, cada efeito conta uma história. E quem dá vida a isso é a animação.
Estamos buscando um(a) Game Animator com energia positiva, olho clínico para movimento e paixão por criar experiências visuais que prendem o jogador na tela.
Se você vê uma animação de slot e já pensa em timing, easing, impacto visual e como fazer o jogador sentir aquele \"quase lá\", essa vaga é para você.
Seu papel aqui
Você será responsável por dar vida aos nossos jogos de cassino — dos símbolos ao feedback de vitória, das transições de tela aos efeitos especiais que fazem o jogador querer mais um spin.
No dia a dia, isso significa:
Criar animações 2 D para símbolos, personagens, UI e efeitos dentro dos jogos
Desenvolver motion design para transições, telas de bônus e celebrações de prêmio
Colaborar com game designers, artistas e devs para garantir que a animação reforce a experiência do jogador
Manter consistência visual e fluidez em diferentes jogos e plataformas
Otimizar animações para performance em web e mobile
Propor soluções criativas que elevem o impacto visual sem comprometer a entrega Você terá liberdade criativa real dentro de um time que valoriza quem traz ideias.
O que é essencial
Experiência com animação 2 D (Spine, After Effects, ou ferramentas equivalentes)
Conhecimento sólido de motion design (timing, easing, peso, antecipação)
Ter trabalhado com jogos — entender o contexto interativo, não só o linear
Portfólio que demonstre qualidade de movimento e atenção a detalhes
Perfil positivo, colaborativo e orientado a solução
Boa comunicação (PT + EN) Diferenciais fortes
Experiência específica em i Gaming (slots/casino)
Conhecimento em animação 3 D (Blender, Cinema 4 D ou similar)
Familiaridade com engines como Unity ou frameworks web (Pixi.js, Create JS)
Interesse prático em IA aplicada a arte ou animação
Noção de UX e como a animação influencia o comportamento do jogador O que você encontra aqui
Autonomia real (sem microgerenciamento)
Ambiente rápido e direto
Produto internacional jogado no mundo todo
Cultura de aprendizado contínuo
Espaço para inovação e experimentação visual Interessado(a)? Candidate-se. Respondemos todas as aplicações.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Performance marketing specialist
description:
Our client operates the #1 AI Agent platform and is one of the fastest-growing AI companies globally (just behind Chat GPT/Open AI and Deep Seek). They've already reached over 100 million users in a very short time, with a clear path toward 500 million next.
The company has built the world's most advanced AI Agent content platform, enabling safe and ethical AI at massive scale.
They've also raised an unusually large seed round from prominent investors after rigorous due diligence, with a major Series A expected.
The company is fully remote and operates in a fast-paced startup / scale-up environment with real ownership. They are now hiring their first Founding Performance Marketing Managers (Junior to Mid level).
The Role:
Hands-on Performance Marketing role scaling user acquisition for a high-traffic B2 C AI platform at global scale
Work closely with CMO, product, creative, and data teams to scale, optimize, and stabilize paid acquisition channels
Own campaign execution end-to-end (Meta, Tik Tok, Snapchat, ASA, Native), including creative testing, funnel iteration, and budget scaling
Reporting directly to the CMO, working alongside other senior growth / UA marketers
Startup / scale-up experience in fast-paced consumer environments strongly preferred
Strong analytical mindset (ROAS, CAC, LTV, cohorts) and ability to translate performance data into creative and funnel improvements is essential
Tech Stack: Meta Ads, Tik Tok Ads, Snapchat, ASA, GA4, Voluum, tracking & attribution tools, internal dashboards, and automation tools Why join?
Total compensation up to 60,000 EUR
Regular salary reviews and potential stock in future
Flexible contract models (B2 B or permanent)
Elite 100% remote team with backgrounds from Tier-1 tech companies
One of the fastest-scaling AI companies globally, with massive real-world adoption
With so much still to be built, your work will have direct, visible impact
As the company scales rapidly, your career will scale with it
Learning budget for courses, conferences, and events
Health & Wellness Support
Brand-new company laptop
Co-working space budget
High ownership in a mission-critical role

description:
Somos o futuro da Gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho!
SOBRE NÓS
A Vixting está revolucionando a Admissão Digital e a Gestão Ocupacional no Brasil!
Com tecnologia de ponta, oferecemos soluções práticas e inteligentes que simplificam a rotina dos nossos clientes. Aqui, nosso foco vai além de serviços: acreditamos nas pessoas e na força de conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão pelo que fazemos.
Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem um valor único e que o alinhamento cultural é o alicerce para relações duradouras e impactantes. Aqui, construímos conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão por superar expectativas
Criamos soluções estratégicas
Somos apaixonados pelo maior ativo de uma companhia: Pessoas! Prezamos a essência de cada ser humano, buscamos o fit cultural para ser a base da nossa relação. Construímos relacionamentos baseados em confiança, caráter, honestidade, ética e paixão por encantar!
DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK SÊNIOR
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Core Técnico: Experiência sólida e comprovada em Node.js, React.js, Type Script e Java Script;
Cloud & Serverless: Vivência prática em ambiente AWS, com foco em arquitetura Serverless e AWS Lambda;
Mensageria: Experiência com sistemas de filas (especialmente AWS SQS);
Banco de Dados: Proficiência em My SQL e Mongo DB;
Dev Ops: Experiência na configuração de fluxos de CI/CD com Git Hub Actions;
Arquitetura: Conhecimento em quebra de monolitos e transição para microsserviços/serverless;
Produtividade: Utilização de ferramentas de IA no fluxo de trabalho diário para ganho de performance. Diferenciais (Serão considerados um grande peso)
Conhecimento em Dynamo DB (banco chave-valor).
Background no setor de Healthtech (especialmente medicina ocupacional).
Experiência prévia em empresas de software para RH, Recrutamento ou Onboarding. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
Nossos Benefícios
Vale refeição de R$36,00 por dia, sendo 22 dias úteis fixos;
Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;
Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;
Plano odontológico Amil;
Wellhub;
Seguro de vida;
Day off.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.
What You'll Get
Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions
● Workshops on social media, product, or design
Rewards & Credit System
We'll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!
Redeem credits for:
● Annual Meitu products membership
● " Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador" Certificate + internship reference
● Meitu Special Deisgn
● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership
● Summer Internship Offer
● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)
About Meitu
Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.
Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357. HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.
At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Gerente de marketing digital
description:
Estamos buscando candidatos para uma vaga em Marketing Digital em um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Você será responsável por criar e implementar campanhas de marketing em plataformas digitais como Facebook, Google, Tik Tok e outros canais de mídia. O trabalho inclui planejamento de conteúdo, gestão de anúncios, monitoramento do desempenho das campanhas e otimização de custos para atingir os objetivos de negócios.
Os candidatos ideais devem ser criativos, proativos e possuir fortes habilidades em análise de dados. Experiência em marketing digital é uma vantagem, mas também damos as boas-vindas a jovens apaixonados e com vontade de aprender. É necessário ter excelentes habilidades de redação de conteúdo, conhecimento básico de SEO, publicidade online e ferramentas de marketing.
Oferecemos salário competitivo, bônus por desempenho e oportunidades claras de crescimento na carreira. Além disso, você receberá treinamento de desenvolvimento profissional e trabalhará em uma equipe amigável e colaborativa. Se você ama marketing e deseja construir uma carreira sólida, candidate-se hoje mesmo.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Tráfego Pago para apoiar a gestão, execução e monitoramento de campanhas de mídia paga em diferentes plataformas.
Esta posição é ideal para profissionais com experiência em campanhas digitais que desejam atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em organização, análise de desempenho e melhoria contínua. O objetivo é garantir a execução consistente das campanhas e o acompanhamento adequado dos resultados.

Perfil analítico e atenção aos detalhes.
Boa organização e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
Interesse em otimização e melhoria contínua de campanhas.

Modelo remoto.
Processos estruturados e suporte interno.
Ambiente colaborativo e profissional.

title: Strategy consultant | ex-mckinsey, bain, bcg, deloitte, kpmg (100% remote)
description:
Apply here:
About the role
We are looking for a sharp, execution-oriented strategy professional to work directly with C-suite clients across multiple industries. You will own workstreams end-to-end, from problem structuring and hypothesis development to stakeholder alignment and final delivery.
This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role designed for professionals who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually demanding environments and who are used to that standard from tier-1 consulting firms.
Who we're looking for:
Professionals with a background in top-tier global strategy or management consulting firms (Mc Kinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, KPMG, Pw C, EY, Oliver Wyman, Roland Berger, or equivalent). The rigor, structure, and pace expected here mirrors what you already know.
What you will do:
Lead hypothesis-driven diagnostic and strategy engagements for clients across sectors
Own workstream delivery: structuring the problem, building the analytical framework, and presenting findings to senior leadership
Drive C-suite and board-level stakeholder management with executive communication and influence
Translate complex data and qualitative insights into clear, actionable strategic recommendations
Support business development conversations and contribute to proposal writing when relevant
Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional, globally distributed teams Apply here:
What we expect
3-8 years of experience in a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm (MBB, Big4 Strategy, or equivalent tier-1 firm)
Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive engagement delivery from kickoff to final output
Strong financial modeling and data analysis skills
Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to C-level executives
Ability to operate with high autonomy in a fully remote, async-first environment
Advanced English Apply here:
This is an external position to work at a Wise VAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that Wise VAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in Wise VAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

professional working level of English.

title: Devops Engineer Sr
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy,and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhanceCI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
    ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  1. Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  2. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  3. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  4. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Analista De Sistema Sr Frontend Angular/Aws
description: A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética. Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor. MISSÃO DO CARGO: Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias. RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação. Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa. Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos. Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional. Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas. Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas. Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção. Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral. REQUISITOS DO CARGO Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins. Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA. Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno. Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos. COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: Product Owner
description: Product Owner - Sênior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás. Como será seu dia a dia? Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
